modalLead: Config opens on Overview when you return normally; your last section is restored only after Shift+H or Shift+I, including cold load on bare #config. Config → Bookmarks rows match Health and Inbox, with Edit opening a prefilled modal. Random theme On view change no longer flashes white in dark mode.

items.text: Overview on return — Shift+S, Escape, and the config link land on Overview; stored section and sub-tab apply only when returning from Health or Inbox (Shift+H / Shift+I). Cold load on bare #config still restores a stored Shift+H/I location (resolveConfigOpenTarget(), restoreConfigSectionFromHash(), dashboard-config-loader.js).
Bookmarks rows like Health/Inbox — shared bookmark-feed-row.js action bar and row styling; Edit opens the prefilled add-bookmark modal instead of an inline row editor (config-view.css, locales).

Random theme without white flash — On view change applies the next palette before paint so dark mode no longer flashes white when switching views (theme-loader.js, visual-settings.js, dashboard-visual.js).

Release docs for v2026.08.04 — What's new modal, Config → Overview → Latest update, CHANGELOG, README, MANUAL, and Config → Help recap; DASHBOARD_RELEASE → 2026.07-dashboard-release-v155, NEXTDASH_WHATS_NEW_DATA_VERSION → whats-new-v213.
